title: PolyProPicks Executor Completion Envelope
description: Canonical result contract for every executor task. Validated by scripts/control-plane/validate-completion-envelope.mjs — a focused dependency-free validator, not a generic JSON Schema engine. Schema 1.1 adds outcome semantics so a terminal PASS, a genuine hard BLOCK, a recoverable execution failure, an external WAIT and a transport pause are distinguishable by machine rather than by trusting the verdict string.

business_result.description: true marks this entry as proof of the mission's BUSINESS RESULT. A PASS verdict requires at least one such entry with a proven or Founder-accepted evidence class.

state_delta_proposal.description: A PROPOSAL only. The writing executor may never mark its own state delta accepted.

outcome_class.description: Semantic outcome. Each class pins exactly one legal verdict — see EXECUTION_ESCALATION_TAXONOMY.json → outcome_classes.

hard_stop.description: REQUIRED when outcome_class is HARD_BLOCKED. A block is only terminal when a canonical hard-stop identifier, exhausted recovery evidence, and a stated reason recovery cannot continue are all present.

checkpoint.description: REQUIRED when outcome_class is TRANSPORT_PAUSE. Preserves resumable state instead of returning a business blocker.

platform_auto_resume.description: State honestly. false means CHECKPOINT_SEMANTICS_HARDENED, PLATFORM_AUTO_RESUME_NOT_PROVEN.

operator_actions.description: REQUIRED for a PASS verdict. Normal contract: one start, zero intermediate, one terminal result.

x-invariants: PASS requires every entry of required_reviewers to appear in invoked_reviewers.
PASS requires a reviewer_receipts entry for every required reviewer.
Every reviewer receipt's reviewed_sha must equal result_sha.
PASS is forbidden when any commands_run entry has a non-zero exit_code.
PASS is forbidden when any tests entry has result FAIL.
PASS is forbidden when blockers is non-empty.
PASS is forbidden when forbidden_actions_respected is false.
PASS is forbidden when worktree_after is unexpected_dirty.
PASS is forbidden when any reviewer receipt verdict is not PASS.
state_delta_proposal.accepted must be false or absent — the writer cannot accept its own state.
outcome_class must carry its one legal verdict (TERMINAL_PASS→PASS, HARD_BLOCKED→BLOCKED, RECOVERABLE_EXECUTION_FAILURE→FAIL, EXTERNAL_WAIT/TRANSPORT_PAUSE→WAIT).
PASS requires at least one evidence entry with business_result true and a proven or Founder-accepted evidence class.
PASS requires operator_actions with start <= 1, intermediate 0, terminal_result 1.
BLOCKED requires a hard_stop record with a canonical hard_stop_id, non-empty recovery_attempts and unrecoverable_evidence.
BLOCKED is forbidden while any recovery_attempts entry has exhausted false — registered recovery must run first.
BLOCKED is forbidden when its justification is unfinished implementation, remaining work, remaining tests, or a failed first attempt.
BLOCKED is forbidden when its justification is session/runtime slice exhaustion — that is TRANSPORT_PAUSE.

BLOCKED is forbidden when its justification matches a canonically recoverable condition (dirty root, missing dependencies, generated drift, existing PR, ordinary CI/deployment wait, reviewer polling, safe state reconciliation, implementation/test correction, transport interruption).
TRANSPORT_PAUSE requires a checkpoint record and never a business blocker.
WAIT must set founder_action none and may not ask the Founder to launch a recovery prompt.
RECOVERABLE_EXECUTION_FAILURE, EXTERNAL_WAIT and TRANSPORT_PAUSE must set founder_action none.
